research_window.scope: AI搜索产品的功能、可用范围或正式生命周期状态变更
research_window.historical_evidence_limit: Sources may be acquired after the window; record later acquisition and historical basis. Do not claim a contemporaneous capture or backfill later GA into the window.

source_runtime_minimum: score-general-e2e 0.25.0 research_sources with explicit verified snapshot reuse; core 0.15.2 Office runtime
python_runtime: Final worker uses the locked Python 3.12 runtime; local no-answer mechanism smoke tests require Python >=3.11 and do not replace final worker acceptance
overall_formula: A=.20*record_contract+.25*time_and_scope+.40*citation_resolution+.15*protected_delivery; S=.50*factual_support+.30*coverage_and_independence+.20*bounded_conclusions; final=.40*A+.60*S only by the production hybrid scorer
record_contract_formula: .20*mean(three parsed deliverables)+.40*mean(four fixed event structural scores)+.20*ledger_schema+.15*mean(three visible linked brief sections)+.05*unambiguous_final_selection
event_structure_formula: mean(required logical fields present, native scalar fields, declared enums, ID relations, unambiguous merged values, visible/editable native cells)
time_and_scope_formula: mean over four fixed slots of .30*independent_dual_time_binding+.30*precision_and_normalization+.20*window_arithmetic+.20*scope_version_evidence_trace
citation_resolution_formula: Over fixed 23 public claim slots: .25*ID graph + .25*independently acquired source binding + .35*original quote at actual locator + .15*declared access/original quote structure
protected_delivery_formula: all protected input SHA intact * mean(XLSX open, JSON open, DOCX open, XLSX visible/editable, DOCX visible/editable); input mutation affects this checkpoint only
layout_equivalence: No fixed Sheet/coordinate/order/template. Public English keys and Chinese aliases, split row tables merged by event_id and transposed native tables are accepted. JSON dates/claims/brief_sections may be source-nested. No giant single-cell JSON or image substitute.
formula_policy: Static native values accepted. Any XLSX formula requires locked Office recalculation after cache clearing, outside frozen Workspace. No cached-value fallback.
date_policy: Real independent literal token/metadata binding, precision and normalization only. Month labels remain calendar labels; unknown publication can pass with readable body/complete metadata and checked reason. No role/stage/identity/window semantic verdict enters rule scoring.
window_arithmetic_policy: Correctly computed in_window/outside/indeterminate is a mechanical observation; actual event eligibility remains semantic. Calendar boundary days without timezone remain indeterminate. Reporting ranges are not actual occurrence instants.
source_policy: Only production sourcebundle; verify manifest/body/text/projection/receipt SHA and ledger bindings. Candidate caches are never trusted. Each acquired body goes through offline source_projection.py with derived receipt/attempt binding for Judge. An unresolved shell/parser/acquisition is evaluation evidence failure.
source_reuse_policy: Only explicit source0.25 reuse accepted after outer framework verifies the self-contained complete origin capsule. Rule verifies current row/wrapper provenance, original GET receipt SHA/identity/time and fresh/reuse counts. Original body/text/projection and network GET times remain historical; reused_at is not a new GET. No old candidate/GT text enters derived evidence.
candidate_error_policy: Missing/corrupt/malformed/hidden candidate artifacts or missing IDs reduce related checkpoints. Modified input does not zero other checkpoints. No selected product/URL allowlist, reference count, or wording oracle.
evaluation_error_policy: Missing/drifted GT, trusted bundle context/parts/identity, locked Office, helper or managed evidence context raises evaluation_error; never generates candidate ability zero.
semantic_boundary: Actual AI-search product identity, meaningful product change, provider identity/region and importance
Whether a real date refers to publication, the selected event/stage or a future plan; actual historical eligibility
Stage strength, availability, not_stated boundaries, change-group deduplication and at least three actual products with both actual provider regions
Claim-specific semantic citation support, original source independence/derivative lineage and honest single-source limitations
Evidence-supported two cross-event trends and one audience action, comparability, user effects and uncertainties
Candidate actual reading/search honesty when observable, including summaries as summaries; absent process observations are not automatic failure
Pool-external answers use the same evidence and semantic path; no reference product/URL/wording match is required
